reviews.x: Not really sure on this one. The concept is great, but the execution is a bit ho-hum. The brush bristles are supposed to be tipped with little plastic nibs to make them softer, but they don't cover the tip properly so it's still scratchy. The part that pushes out to remove fur buildup is pretty plasticy and flimsy and pushes out a little too far - I feel like at some point the bristles will get bent and stuck behind it.  All that said, my cat does like this brush, and it does an okay job of gett

$7 - You get what you pay for. I purchased based on reviews but I should have known better @ pricepoint.  I do not like it. It's too large/clunky. Bigger than I expected.. Feels cheap. I wanted a brush that "self cleans". The brush does not brush nearly as well as the one I am trying to replace, hardly gets any hair out. The push lever works fine but pointless if it's not pulling the shedded hair. Not impressed. Looking for something else.

reviews.t: Addendum after brush handle breaks off
reviews.x: It seemed like a good quality brush…for 7 months. Then the handle broke off. I’m trying super glue. This brush was put into very ordinary use. We have another brush that’s decades old and holding up nicely…which is to say: The brushes in this house are not abused. So, for a buck per month I guess we’be gotten some use out of it.  Two out of three love it and really do push cheeks against it. #3 tolerates it more than any other comb, brush, or rake. It gets in there, even on long, thick fur. We a

reviews.t: Very good at picking up hair under coat and cleaning out is a breeze
reviews.x: I have used two other cat brushes before this, and this one makes it really easy. It also gets off more hair with just a few passes, which is key for not getting viciously attacked by my cat. She even purs! She was having a lot of hairball problems, and after a week of using this brush, she hasn't had one.

Bought this for my new puppy who is shedding right now. Thought the brush design that allows you to clean it if hair easily seemed like a good idea. Got it today and it works great. No issues, dog likes it, and cleans itself as advertised. Would recommend.

[[VIDEOID:a4c2a5ccd985f141af0d467ae94364af]] Was so skeptical at first..... But It Actually Works great! I normally don't write reviews but I'm definitely happy with this purchase. 😊 And so is my cat, she loves it too. Will recommend to everyone 👍🏻

The product works as described however it seems to be painful and hurts my dog when brushing. She whimpers and yelps which she did not do with her other brush. Will be buying her old brush which seemed to have more comfortable bristles

reviews.t: Snapped from the handle while combing my dog this morning
reviews.x: Used three times in total. Snapped from the handle while I was combing my dog this morning. Unbelievably bad quality. The condition is still perfect as I only used it three times, but it’s no longer usable. Wasted.
My cats and dogs don't mind me brushing them with this brush.  It is easy to clean out once done with the bush of the button.

reviews.t: Very hard on a small dog
reviews.x: Very hard on a small dog! Waste of money

reviews.t: Works, but probably best for long haired animals
reviews.x: I bought the brush for my two short haired dogs. Both of them have been shedding like crazy. The brush does work; however, I think it would work best for long haired animals. It’s pretty much the same as my hair brush. My big dog is Great Dane and he was shaking out every time I stopped which tells me he felt the removal of hair. The pictures are of the brush when I brushed him. As you can see it’s undercoat hair. It didn’t do much for his regular hair because I can still use my hand to push tha

I have a golden/border collie with ear tufts and longer hair on his legs that get stuff stuck in them -- especially all the fancy bark dust I bought in the spring. I use this as an outside brush to get a quick brush out so he doesn't track little bits inside. On his shorter hair areas I have to be careful to not apply too much pressure because that can irritate his skin. On longer hair it gets through tangles pretty well before they start. He also hates being brushed so every little bit helps. L

reviews.t: gentle on delicate skin. super easy to clean.
reviews.x: i've tried many slicker brushes for my pups over the years. i was first attracted to the shape of this brush; most slicker brushes are rectangular, making it awkward to brush various areas of my dogs because of their small size. one of my dogs has delicate skin, so he didnt like being groomed with other brushes because they hurt his skin. the silicone caps on the wires made the brushing process so much easier and he didn't fuss at all! i was worried that the caps would get in the way of cleaning

reviews.t: Will Take Getting Used To, But Good Brush
reviews.x: I really appreciate the ease of the self-cleaning feature, and the brush seems to remove a decent amount of hair considering the very short time my newly adopted cat allowed me to use it so far. I am sure with some time he can get more used to it. This seemed to be one of the most affordable brushes with a higher rating still on Amazon, and I am glad I opted to not shell out any more money, just in case I do not end up getting much use out of it. Good to have still, as I think it's more the brus

This brush works great. I have a couple of older cats whose short and medium haired fur gets matted. This brush removes the mats as well as loose fur. Both cats love the grooming, one doesn’t want me to stop brushing her. This brush is easy to hold, and easy to control so the grooming is light and gentle. I love the push button release for cleaning the bristles. It seems well made. I can definitely recommend this brush for short to medium haired cats.

My kitten is still a little small for this brush, but loves it just the same! As you can see, she still thinks it's a play toy, so it's hard to capture a good image. She also doesn't shed much, so there wasn't enough fur to "eject" out of brush. I can say, though, that the mechanism that releases the hair works very nicely. The only negative about the brush is that, even though the needles are capped at the end, they're still a bit sharp.

Love the size of this brush. Easy to hold, easy to use and, best part, easy to clean! My cat was unsure of it at first, but after rubbing her head and chin against it, she was satisfied it wasn't going to be a bad thing. I didn't realize how much she really needed a good brushing - she looks fabulous, and I'm sure she feels better too! Tried it on my English Cocker Spaniel as well and she just stood there loving it! Highly recommend!!

It works efficiently is easy to remove hair. The plastic piece that goes up the ends of the bristles goes all the way up. Much better than other brand i have tried. Grabs her hair well. Feels durable and comfortable to grip. Seems more comfortable to her too bc the tips of the bristles aren't sharp or pointy they have a bit of a knob to protect her from discomfort but not so large the hair cannot be removed completely. Im very happy.

reviews.t: One of the Greatess Cat Brushes i have brought
reviews.x: I got this brush for My Fur Baby Princess , she's very picky on what type of brush we use on her. So i was nervious she might not like it or it might not help take out lose hairs as good like some brushes i brought before. I was very suprise that she really loves this brush and it really get all the lose hair off. She also loves the lil beads onn.v it cause it massages her back. I Would recommend to all.

I bought this item for my short hair cat after using several different grooming tools that didn’t pick up any hair at all. My house was covered in fur until I used this product. My cat purrs while I’m brushing him, and the brush actually picks up more loose fur than I expected. It’s easy to clean as well. Much better than the grooming gloves that are difficult to clean. Awesome for the shedding months.

reviews.t: I was so excited for this brush!
reviews.x: I thought this brush was well designed and was perfect for my new kitty! It turns out she might not shed very much or at all so when I brushed her for the first time there was not a single hair that came off of her. I love the idea of this brush and will be keeping it for when she grows more hair. She loved how soft it was on her fur and kept wanting more! A great brush :)

I have two geriatric cats who have a harder time grooming themselves and this was a great purchase for them. I was using a silicone mitt but jt was very hard to get the hair off of it without making a mess everywhere. I can brush them with this anywhere in my house and the hair stays on the brush until I’m ready to push the button - and then it goes right in the trash.

The bristles on this brush are like needles, all 3 of my animals wince when I use this on them. The self cleaning feature doesn't work as easily as they say either, still lots of fur left behind. I would NOT recommend this to any pet lover, there are better, more efficient brushes that don't make your beloved pet feel like they're being punished.

reviews.t: cool little brush for the Money.
reviews.x: I had been looking for a brush for my dog for a while that was self-cleaning and also had the soft balls at the end of the bristles. There were many for much more $$$ than this one but I went with this one because it had all the features I wanted PLUS it was cute :). I am happy with my purchase, as its gentle, cleans easily and gets the job done!

This product is great ! My cat sheds a lot and holding the brush for extended periods of time hurts my hand. This brush is so easy to hold that I don’t have that problem and it’s really easy to clean. All you have to do is just push the button on the back and voila all the fur is off the brush, it makes it so easy to remove !!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the brush effective at removing loose hair and mats, and easy to clean thanks to the self-cleaning feature.
Several reviewers report the brush is too harsh or painful, especially on small or delicate-skinned animals.
Some reviewers complain about poor build quality, with the handle breaking or snapping after limited use.
A few reviewers find the brush clunky, cheap-feeling, or less effective than expected for the price.
Some reviewers note the brush works better for long-haired animals than for short-haired ones.
